test_case_name: Accept all cookies on parent page and then accept cookies on child page

intents.intent: Click 'Acconsento' on the parent page to accept all cookies
Click 'ACCONSENTO' on the child page to accept all cookies
And then check that the cookie banners are dismissed on both pages

test_case_name: Reject cookies on parent page and select more options on child page

intents.intent: Click 'Più opzioni' on the parent page to view cookie policy
Click 'PIÙ OPZIONI' on the child page to view more cookie options
And then check that the user is redirected to the cookie policy or options page on both sites

test_case_name: Navigate from parent to child via 'Gruppo' link and accept cookies

intents.intent: Click 'Gruppo' on the parent page to navigate to the child page
Click 'ACCONSENTO' on the child page to accept all cookies
And then check that the cookie banner is dismissed on the child page

test_case_name: Navigate from parent to child via 'Gruppo' link and open search on child page

intents.intent: Click 'Gruppo' on the parent page to navigate to the child page
Click the button with class 'header-navbar-btn-search' on the child page to open the search bar
And then check that the search input with placeholder 'Cerca' is visible on the child page

test_case_name: Search for content on child page after navigating from parent

intents.intent: Click 'Gruppo' on the parent page to navigate to the child page
Click the button with class 'header-navbar-btn-search' on the child page to open the search bar
Type $name into the input with placeholder 'Cerca' on the child page
Click the button with class 'btn-search' and data-name 'search-button' on the child page to submit the search
And then check that the search results are displayed on the child page

test_case_name: Access 'SCOPRI DI PIÙ' exhibition link from child page after navigating from parent

intents.intent: Click 'Gruppo' on the parent page to navigate to the child page
Click 'SCOPRI DI PIÙ' on the child page to access the exhibition site
And then check that the user is redirected to the external exhibition website

test_case_name: Switch language to English on child page after navigating from parent

intents.intent: Click 'Gruppo' on the parent page to navigate to the child page
Click 'EN' on the child page to switch the language to English
And then check that the page content is displayed in English

test_case_name: Open and close the gallery on child page after navigating from parent

intents.intent: Click 'Gruppo' on the parent page to navigate to the child page
Click 'Carica altre immagini' on the child page to load more images in the gallery
Click the button with class 'pswp__button--close' on the child page to close the gallery
And then check that the gallery is closed and the main content is visible

test_case_name: Navigate to 'Persone e Famiglie' section from child page footer

intents.intent: Click 'Persone e Famiglie' in the footer of the child page to navigate back to the parent site section
And then check that the 'Persone e Famiglie' section of the parent site is displayed

test_case_name: Navigate to 'Business' section from child page footer

intents.intent: Click 'Business' in the footer of the child page to navigate to the parent site business section
And then check that the 'Business' section of the parent site is displayed

test_case_name: Navigate to 'Corporate' section from child page footer

intents.intent: Click 'Corporate' in the footer of the child page to navigate to the corporate site
And then check that the corporate site is displayed
